description.en: Create and run conditional sequences, nested if/else branches, wait conditions, delays, HTTP requests, and cross-integration entity commands. Runs directly on Remote Two/3 or as an external integration with the same web interface and configuration format.

value.en: Advanced Automations can run directly on this Remote or as an external service. After setup, open the web interface on port 8099 of the device running the integration. For a Remote installation use http://REMOTE-IP:8099; for an external installation use http://SERVER-IP:8099. Configure a Remote Core API key, then create automations.
